components.css: .ds-canvas { background: #F2F2F7; padding: 16px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: #fff; border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; padding: 12px 16px; min-height: 64px; border: none; border-bottom: 0.5px solid rgba(60, 60, 67, 0.12); background: transparent; text-align: left; color: #000; cursor: pointer; } .ds-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-row:hover, .ds-row:active { background: rgba(120, 120, 128, 0.16); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #007AFF; outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-row-copy { display: flex; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; min-width: 0; } .ds-row-copy strong { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; color: #418FC5; } .ds-row-copy span { font-size: 15px; color: rgba(60, 60, 67, 0.6); } .ds-eta { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 1px; min-width: 44px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1; } .ds-eta > span { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.5px; color: #000; } .ds-eta small { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(60, 60, 67, 0.6); }

narrative.overview:
P2P Live’s public rider app reads like an Apple system app on campus: Maps, Weather, and Find My grammar applied to next-bus timing. The first question a walking student asks—when is the next ride—answers in one large, tabular number on a white inset surface over iOS systemGroupedBackground. Chrome is frosted and hairline-thin; content lists are inset and grouped. Brand color is reserved: Express blue and Baity red mark routes and the P2P wordmark only. Interactive chrome speaks system blue (#007AFF), not brand blue.

Density stays phone-first and thumb-reachable. Large titles, 44–50px controls, and a translucent tab bar replace web-dashboard chrome. Depth comes from materials (blur + saturate) and tonal layering (grouped gray vs white inset), not from card stacks or multi-layer drop shadows on resting content.
keyCharacteristics: iOS systemGroupedBackground (#F2F2F7) canvas with inset white lists
SF / -apple-system stack; large titles and tabular ETAs
Hairline separators; frosted nav material on header and tab bar
System tint for actions; P2P blue/red only for routes + wordmark
Glance-first next-ride surface before secondary lists or map chrome
Status ink (success/warning), urgency washes, and a night-only off-hours card

rules.name: The Route Color Reserve Rule
rules.body: Express blue and Baity red appear only on route identity (pills, row titles, map tags) and the P2P wordmark. They never paint primary buttons, tab selection, or page chrome.

rules.name: The System Tint Rule
rules.body: Interactive chrome—primary CTA, selected tab, back links, focus rings—uses system tint (#007AFF), not Express blue.

rules.name: The Glance Number Rule
rules.body: The next-arrival figure is the loudest type on Home—tabular, heavy, and larger than any surrounding label. Supporting copy stays secondary-label gray.

rules.name: The No Caps Chrome Rule
rules.body: Section labels and sheet headings stay sentence case; do not revive uppercase micro-headers.

rules.name: The One Column Phone Rule
rules.body: Rider surfaces stay a single centered column; desktop only widens padding, never invents sidebar chrome.

rules.name: The Flat Inset Rule
rules.body: Grouped lists and catch cards at rest cast no shadow—depth is the gray canvas showing around white insets. Shadows belong to floating map chrome and sheets.

dos: Do open Home with frosted wordmark, status line, large next-ride surface, then one inset bus list above the translucent tab bar.
Do use system tint for CTAs, selected tabs, and focus; reserve Express/Baity for route identity and the wordmark.
Do stack white inset groups on #F2F2F7 with hairline row separators and flat resting surfaces.
Do keep ETA digits tabular and larger than surrounding labels.
Do frost floating map chips/controls; keep stroke icons light (~1.75) like SF Symbols.
donts: Don't paint primary buttons or tab selection with Express blue or Baity red.
Don't introduce dashboard cards, dense multi-column layouts, or opaque web chrome on rider surfaces.
Don't put resting drop shadows on inset lists or catch cards.
Don't use uppercase eyebrow/kicker labels for section chrome.
Don't treat the night empty card as a global dark mode—daylight grouped materials remain the system.
